title: New AOAC Validation
desc: Our Multiplex PCR kits received new validation for complex dairy matrices.
fullContent:
We are proud to announce that our research team in the Boston Hub has successfully completed the AOAC validation process for our Salmonella + Listeria multiplex kits.

This milestone allows US laboratories to implement faster testing protocols with full regulatory confidence. The new protocols reduce enrichment time by 40% compared to traditional methods.

Contact your local distributor to get started.
